text: 【中国人民银行副行长宣昌能会见法国财政总署署长杜蒙】2026年10月23日，中国人民银行副行长宣昌能会见法国财政总署署长杜蒙。双方就当前经济金融形势、中法经济金融合作等议题进行了交流。
text_en: [PBOC Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng meets with French Treasury Director General Dumont] On October 23, 2026, PBOC Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng met with French Treasury Director General Dumont. The two sides exchanged views on the current economic and financial situation, China-France economic and financial cooperation and other topics.
